customer_complaint: The engine produces a continuous rattling noise when accelerating, particularly during cold starts.
technician_diagnosis: Inspected the engine and identified abnormal noise around the timing chain assembly. Suspect timing chain tensioner failure.

recommended_repair.recommended_action: Replace the complete engine block to resolve the noise

customer_complaint: Squealing noise from the front wheels when braking at low speed.
technician_diagnosis: Front brake pads worn below minimum thickness. Rotors show minor scoring within resurfacing tolerance.

recommended_repair.recommended_action: Replace front brake pads and resurface rotors

customer_complaint: Engine temperature gauge rises to the red zone after approximately 20 minutes of highway driving. No visible coolant leak.
technician_diagnosis: Pressure test passed. Water pump impeller shows cavitation damage. Thermostat opens within spec. Recommend water pump replacement.

customer_complaint: Battery warning light illuminated on the dashboard. Headlights dim noticeably when the air conditioning is running.
technician_diagnosis: Alternator output measured at 11.2V under load, below the 13.5V minimum. Alternator internal regulator failure confirmed.

customer_complaint: Air conditioning blows warm air on the driver side but cold air on the passenger side.
technician_diagnosis: Blend door actuator on the driver side is not responding to temperature input. Clicking noise heard behind the dashboard.

customer_complaint: Clunking noise from the front suspension when driving over bumps or uneven roads.
technician_diagnosis: Front stabilizer bar end links worn. Bushings cracked and play detected on both sides.

recommended_repair.recommended_action: Replace front stabilizer bar end links on both sides

customer_complaint: Transmission hesitates and jerks when shifting from second to third gear. Worse under light acceleration.
technician_diagnosis: Transmission fluid is within spec. Adaptive shift strategy reset did not resolve the issue. Suspect valve body solenoid pack malfunction.

recommended_repair.recommended_action: Replace transmission valve body and solenoid pack

customer_complaint: Engine rattling noise heard at idle and during low-speed acceleration.
technician_diagnosis: Timing chain stretch suspected based on noise pattern. No fault codes present.

recommended_repair.part_description: Timing chain kit with guides and tensioner
recommended_repair.recommended_action: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner

customer_complaint: Vehicle pulls to the right when braking. Vibration felt through the steering wheel.
technician_diagnosis: Right front brake caliper is sticking. Rotor shows uneven wear pattern consistent with caliper drag.

recommended_repair.recommended_action: Replace right front brake caliper and rotor

customer_complaint: Air conditioning is not cooling the cabin. Compressor clutch does not engage.
technician_diagnosis: Refrigerant level is low. Unable to locate the source of the leak. Recommend compressor replacement.

recommended_repair.recommended_action: Replace A/C compressor assembly and recharge system

customer_complaint: Check engine light on. Loss of power when towing uphill.
technician_diagnosis: Diagnostic code P0401: EGR insufficient flow. Visual inspection inconclusive. No further diagnostics performed.

recommended_repair.recommended_action: Replace EGR cooler and valve assembly
